{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define the final population: converted == 1, not QA, and valid age
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
converted_not_qa = (df['converted'] == 1) & (~qa_mask)
valid_age_mask = df['customer_age'] != -1
final_mask = converted_not_qa & valid_age_mask

# Extract the age values
final_ages = df.loc[final_mask, 'customer_age']

# Compute the mean
mean_age = final_ages.mean()

# Confirm the count
n_converted = final_mask.sum()

print(f"Number of converted customers (excluding QA and -1): {n_converted}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age:.2f}")"}
